STATE OF CALIFORNIA
DEPARTMENT OF MANAGED HEALTH CARE
INDEPENDENT MEDICAL REVIEW (IMR) / COMPLAINT FORM
DMHC 20-224 (Rev 09/2025)

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

You can submit your IMR/Complaint form online at: www.HealthHelp.ca.gov (This is the fastest way to submit!)

OR mail to:
Help Center
Department of Managed Health Care
980 9th Street, Suite 500
Sacramento, CA 95814-2725

OR FAX to: 916-255-5241

Section 1: Patient Information
Patient's Name:
Address:
City: State: Zip:
Daytime Phone: Evening Phone:
Email:
Health Plan Name:
Member ID Number:

Section 2: Complaint Information
1. Have you filed a grievance (complaint) with your health plan? [ ] Yes [ ] No
2. Have you received a written decision from your health plan? [ ] Yes [ ] No
3. Does your complaint involve a request for an Independent Medical Review (IMR)? [ ] Yes [ ] No
   - Was the service denied as NOT MEDICALLY NECESSARY? [ ] Yes [ ] No
   - Was the service denied as EXPERIMENTAL or INVESTIGATIONAL? [ ] Yes [ ] No
   - Was the service denied as an OUT-OF-NETWORK referral? [ ] Yes [ ] No

Section 3: Complaint Details
Please describe your problem with the health plan. Be as specific as possible, including names, dates, and places. You may attach additional pages and copies of documents (such as denial letters, bills, or medical records).

Section 4: Authorization and Signature
I authorize the DMHC to review my medical records and to contact my health plan regarding this complaint. I understand that the information provided may be shared with the health plan for the purpose of resolving this dispute.

Signature: ________________________________ Date: ________________

(Note: If the patient is a minor or unable to sign, a legal representative must sign and provide proof of authority.)
